text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Mejiro Ramonu was taking part in a joint dance lesson,
I went along to observe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The assigned song this time is a lovely, flower-themed piece
full of sweetness. You could say it's the exact opposite
of Mejiro Ramonu's usual image.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ――? I am, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Just like a race, you can't create
heat in a live performance all by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Those two over there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I wonder whose dance
caught your eye?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
――"Lovely," aren't I?
And that's not all I am, either.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ramonu-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful, lovely—red rose.
A rose concealing fierce thorns.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: If we want to refine our beauty even further—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
It's the exact same choreography as mine, but...
it looks completely different...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Your dance lays your hidden thorns bare.
Though one would never notice unless they drew close enough to touch."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That's not bad either.
I chose to keep mine... a bit more hidden.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"As the old saying goes:
'Hidden, it blossoms; the height of love is a love kept secret'—so they say."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I see, even with the same rose,
such distinct nuances emerge just from changing the expression...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let me check my expressions more carefully too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ramonu and Daiwa Scarlet digested and absorbed each other's dance styles, further refining their own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“—Adorable.
Is that all there is to it?”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ramonu-san...!
Um, well...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Lovely little daisies.
They bring an effortless smile to the face of anyone who sees them—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Wah!
It's pretty... but also a little cute!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to be like Ramonu-san too...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Please do not imitate me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Love may be love, but in your case—it is benevolence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: The cherry blossoms bloom in full glory, as if shielding the passersby below.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Love can take whatever form you wish.
Go ahead and refine your own love."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu digested and absorbed Nishino Flower's
dance style, refining it into a completely different form.
